_note: ADDED 2026-09-14 on Daniel's call. Organizers ask for 'a piano player' by name in the planner threads, galas seat a pianist at dinner, and hotels sell the ballroom and leave the music to the planner. Listing only until 2026-09-23, when Daniel asked for a page ("build pages for solo piano and last consulate too"). No Denver phrase for a pianist autocompletes, so the page carries the generic head terms that do ("pianist for hire", "pianist for events", "piano player denver") and the occasions the site already sends a pianist to.
blurb: A pianist through arrival, cocktails and dinner, standards and covers at a level the table talks across, with a voice added when the evening wants singing. This is the booking for a hotel ballroom or a client dinner.
